entities.summary: Fedir Zakharovich Babachenko was a Junior Lieutenant and chief of intelligence in the 323rd Artillery Regiment of the 123rd Infantry Division in the 7th Army on the Northwestern Front during the Winter War. For his actions in the war he was awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union on 11 April 1940 before he went missing in action during the Second World War in 1944 and as presumed to have been killed in after he was captured.
